description: DEV-047 T12 / BUG-080: draft a D6 x 3 mm boss by 11 degrees with the existing creo_execute_plan draft operation. The draft target is a REAL face reference: first create the boss, then read the cylindrical side face from creo_inspect_model (surfaces entry with type PRO_SRF_CYLINDER, radius 3 and an axis parallel to Z) and pass its geometry id as surfaces[0].id. Never guess or hardcode face ids from another model. With the neutral plane at the boss base (z=0) the top narrows to r_top = 3 - 3*tan(11 deg) and the boss becomes a cone frustum, so the final volume is pi*h/3*(R^2 + R*r_top + r_top^2) with R=3, h=3; verify it against volume_mm3 after the save-reload instead of trusting a screenshot.

request.model_id: <existing managed part model_id or a fresh creo_new_part result>

expect.job: status succeeded; result.saved_file_reloaded_and_verified is true; the revision advances by 1 for the whole job
expect.operations: three input operations produce exactly three ordered results with zero-based index 0-2 under the 0.7.0 result contract
expect.geometry: top radius r_top = 3 - 3*tan(11 deg) ~= 2.416859 mm; final volume = pi*h/3*(R^2 + R*r_top + r_top^2) with R=3, h=3 gives ~= 69.403 mm^3 versus the prismatic 27*pi ~= 84.823 mm^3, i.e. the draft removes ~= 15.420 mm^3; assert the frustum volume itself via volume_mm3, not only the removed difference
expect.direction: angle is measured against the neutral plane; on the verified Creo 12.4 machine the default direction flares the boss outward (volume grows to the flared frustum), and flip:true produces the narrowing draft with r_top = 3 - 3*tan(11 deg). Assert the frustum volume of the direction you intended; never silently accept either one
